text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? I can hear the shrine festival 
music from afar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was walking through 
town with Mejiro Ardan after finishing our 
shopping. Following the sound of festival 
music, we walked on and...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, what a coincidence! Did you 
folks come here for the festival too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, Inari. Yes... I got lured over by the 
sound of festival music and took a little 
detour.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're here, enjoy the festival to 
your heart's content! The festival dance 
is just getting started!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, it sounds very intriguing, but... I'm 
afraid I don't know how to dance this 
ondo.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't sweat the small stuff. In stuff 
like this, whoever has the most fun wins!
choice_data_list: Let's stick to a dance we're used to.
First... let's try copying the dance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"In that case... it's a waltz, but. Um, if 
I have to match this festival beat..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Well, would you look at that! 
You're actually pretty spot on, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That big sister's dance is so pretty! 
I wanna dance too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Shall we take this on as a new 
challenge, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hah...! H-heave... ho...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Well, would you look at that! 
You're actually pretty spot on, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Festival-Loving Guy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's one stylish dance! We can't 
let ourselves lose to that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, love that look on your face! Looks 
like you had yourself a proper good time 
at the festival!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Becoming one at heart with a 
stranger through dance. I understand now. 
What Inari-san meant by a festival is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A true Winning Live...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've always wondered. Why are Inari-san's 
Winning Lives so magnificent... and so 
thrilling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I believe it is surely because the art of 
connecting hearts through dance like this 
has become second nature to them."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, well... I ain't ever thought about 
anything that grand, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. It makes me really happy to see you 
care that much about my favorite festival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the festival, she gained valuable 
lessons for her live performances!
